# Implementation Plan: tickets-dashboard

**Branch**: `001-tickets-dashboard` | **Date**: 2026-04-24 | **Spec**: specs/001-tickets-dashboard/spec.md
**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/001-tickets-dashboard/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by /speckit.plan and filled with decisions resolved in research.md.

## Summary

Crear la página de dashboard de tickets con tabla paginada (25/50), filtros por prioridad y estado, ordenación por columnas y un CTA "New Ticket" que abre el formulario en /tickets/new. La UI usará Angular Material, seguirá prácticas TDD y reconsultará la lista tras creación para garantizar aparición en ≤5s.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: TypeScript (Angular project, use the repo's Angular version)  
**Primary Dependencies**: Angular, Angular Material, RxJS, project i18n utilities (existing), date-fns or Intl for formatting  
**Storage**: N/A (frontend) — relies on backend API endpoints GET /tickets, POST /tickets  
**Testing**: Jest for unit tests (Angular Testing Library), Cypress for e2e (conforming with constitution)  
**Target Platform**: Modern browsers (desktop/tablet/mobile responsive)  
**Project Type**: Web application (frontend)  
**Performance Goals**: p95 for list API & UI interactions < 200 ms (project non-functional target); perceived snappy UI (skeletons/loading)  
**Constraints**: Table must render up to 50 rows without layout overflow; API p95 target may require backend tuning; re-query strategy for consistency if no push available  
**Scale/Scope**: Feature-level scope (one feature module tickets); expected to handle typical support workloads (no strict user count defined — NEEDS CLARIFICATION if >10k concurrent users expected)

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

Relevant constitution requirements and evaluation:

- TDD mandatory (Constitution V & XI): Plan requires writing unit tests first (Jest) and e2e for critical flows (Cypress). PASS — planning commits to TDD and test coverage steps.
- Coverage minimum 80% (Constitution VI & XI): Plan mandates tests and CI checks to achieve >=80% global coverage. PASS — no violation.
- Accessibility (Constitution IV, XIV): Use Angular Material, ARIA, keyboard navigation, contrast and a11y tests in e2e. PASS.
- Observability & Error handling (Constitution VII & XV): Implement centralized error handler and structured logs; show friendly error UX. PASS.
- Performance & lazy-loading (Constitution VIII): Tickets module will be lazy-loaded; use request debouncing and cancelation. PASS.

No constitution gates are violated by the chosen approach. All mandatory rules are explicitly addressed and will be validated by tests and CI. Any departures must be justified in Complexity Tracking.

### Código fuente (raíz del repo)

Implementaremos el módulo feature lazy-loaded en `src/app/tickets`.

```text
frontend/
└── src/
    ├── app/
    │   ├── tickets/                     # Módulo feature tickets (lazy-loaded)
    │   │   ├── tickets.module.ts        # Declaraciones, rutas de feature
    │   │   ├── components/
    │   │   │   ├── tickets-table/       # TicketsTableComponent
    │   │   │   ├── ticket-row/          # TicketRowComponent
    │   │   │   └── ticket-filters/      # TicketFiltersComponent
    │   │   ├── pages/
    │   │   │   ├── tickets-list-page/   # TicketsListPage (ruta: /tickets)
    │   │   │   └── ticket-create-page/  # TicketCreatePage (ruta: /tickets/new)
    │   │   ├── services/
    │   │   │   ├── tickets-api.service.ts
    │   │   │   └── tickets-state.service.ts
    │   │   └── models/
    │   │       └── index.ts             # Interfaces: Ticket, User, PaginationMeta
    │   └── ... (otros módulos de la app)
    ├── assets/
    └── styles/
```

Pruebas:

```text
# Unit tests (feature)
src/app/tickets/__tests__/*.spec.ts

# E2E tests
e2e/tickets/*.cy.ts   # o tests/e2e/tickets/ según convención del repo
```

Decisión breve: se elige la opción "Aplicación web" porque el repositorio ya contiene el frontend Angular; implementar un módulo feature en `src/app/tickets` permite lazy-loading, separación clara de responsabilidades y fácil integración con Angular Material y las pruebas (unitarias y e2e). Rutas principales: `/tickets` (listado) y `/tickets/new` (creación). Paths clave: `src/app/tickets/`, `src/app/tickets/components/`, `src/app/tickets/pages/`, `src/app/tickets/services/`, `src/app/tickets/models/`, `src/app/tickets/tickets.module.ts`.
